feed.summary: The EEOC has filed a lawsuit against Coca-Cola Beverages Northeast, Inc., alleging that a "women-only" employee event constitutes sex discrimination under Title VII. This action is part of the EEOC's broader initiative to combat what it deems "unlawful DEI-motivated race and sex discrimination." The EEOC is seeking injunctive relief, policy changes, and compensatory damages for male employees excluded from the event.

feed.summary: Procter & Gamble (NYSE:PG) has re-signed as a top-level sponsor for USA Gymnastics for the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics, marking the first partner to return since recent scandals.
